column1: # Acknowledged hits of the public snapshot's audit (projects/felix/snapshot.sh).
# A row waives one leak check, so it is a person's judgment, reviewed in the pull
# request that adds it. snapshot.sh reads this file as main holds it, prints the
# row a person could add, and never writes here. Withheld from the snapshot: it
# names what the audit searches for.
#   path<TAB>git hash-object of the line<TAB>why the line is not what the audit feared
#     Editing the line voids its row.
#   @name<TAB>name<TAB>why it is not searched for
#     The audit searches for every directory name in the memory root; this is
#     the only way one leaves that source. It leaves no other: the same name
#     under projects/ on main or on disk, in a remote or given with --name is
#     still searched for, so a leftover that later becomes a project is found.
# Carried from the untracked ~/.felix/memory/felix/snapshot-ack.tsv, where an
# agent wrote them on 2026-09-21. Each hash was re-checked on 2026-09-22 against
# the line it names at a3eee3c and at 31ed8a8.
# Not carried: the row for templates/unattended.yml:138, whose why called
# felix@users.noreply.github.com "no person's address". It is GitHub's no-reply
# address for the account named felix, a person's. Since 2026-09-22 the template
# commits as GitHub's own Actions identity, whose [bot] address the audit passes
# by rule, so no row is needed and none should be added for the old line.
